blocked.name: Eumidian Wastewaker
blocked.why: "You and defending player each discard a card or sacrifice a permanent": a forced per-player choice between a discard and a sacrifice (only the possible one offered), you then the defending player, done together, then counted for land cards. each-player-may's options are optional and its villainous choices offer impossible options; there is no "you and trigger-player" scope. Encore itself exists.

blocked.name: Baloth Prime
blocked.why: Enters tapped with six stun counters (rule 122.1d): the engine has no stun-counter untap replacement.

blocked.name: Exploration Broodship
blocked.why: Station and its bands exist, but StaticAbility.castFromGraveyard has no additional sacrifice cost (only payLife): "cast a permanent spell from your graveyard by sacrificing a land in addition to paying its other costs".

blocked.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
blocked.why: CardFilter.sharesCardTypeWith "sacrificed" exists, but only a cost or a sacrifice-source step binds the "sacrificed" ref; the chosen "you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker" inside an effect does not.

blocked.name: God-Eternal Bontu
blocked.why: "Sacrifice any number of other permanents, then draw that many" needs a chosen any-number sacrifice made as one event (choose-permanents applies its then one permanent at a time); and put-on-library has only top/bottom, not "third from the top".

blocked.name: Moraug, Fury of Akoum
blocked.why: +1/+0 for each time each creature has attacked this turn (GameObject.attackedThisTurn is a boolean), and an additional combat straight after a main phase (no extra main) with an untap at the beginning of that combat.

blocked.name: Augur of Autumn
blocked.why: "You may look at the top card of your library any time" is private (revealsOwnLibraryTop reveals it to every player), and Coven (three or more creatures with different powers) isn't a StaticCondition.

blocked.name: Formless Genesis
blocked.why: A Kindred Sorcery with changeling (the Kindred card type isn't modeled) and retrace (rule 702.81), which isn't built.

blocked.name: Loamcrafter Faun
blocked.why: "You may discard one or more land cards. When you do, return up to that many target nonland permanent cards": a discard of any number of land cards, and a reflexive trigger whose target count is that number.

blocked.name: Multani, Yavimaya's Avatar
blocked.why: "Return two lands you control to their owner's hand" as an activation cost; AbilityCost has no bounce cost.

blocked.name: Pest Infestation
blocked.why: "Destroy up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments": an any-number group's max is a fixed number, not the spell's X.

blocked.name: Soul of Windgrace
blocked.why: "Put a land card from a graveyard onto the battlefield tapped under your control" is untargeted and reaches every graveyard; return-from-graveyard and look-and-choose only reach your own.

blocked.name: Windgrace's Judgment
blocked.why: "For any number of opponents, destroy target nonland permanent that player controls": at most one target per opponent, which no target spec relates.

blocked.name: Worldsoul's Rage
blocked.why: "Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped" is one choice across two zones and one simultaneous entry; look-and-choose reads one zone.
